scope: Separate bounded owner configuration preparation from paid task deadlines and safely close unverified refresh intents without rewriting history or granting execution.
riskAnalysis: The original ten-minute task expired after a configuration refresh, before final reset acknowledgment. Preserve the partial intent and canceled deployment. Add explicit owner-only cancellation and a new-record-only24hour configuration lease; no paid, complete, model, token or funding deadline extension.

threatModel.assets: Dedicated credentials, immutable owner records, source identity and existing testing exposure must remain isolated from models and frontend inputs.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Fresh authenticated owner may journal bounded configuration operations. Trusted Work operator verifies separate provider metadata; its commitment is an attestation, not provider authentication. Model roles have no configuration or publication authority.
threatModel.abuseCases: Expired task reuse for inference, canceled-task dispatch, stale CAS snapshots, replay of unknown provider operations, forged cancellation, cross-workspace intent access, bypass of original missing ACKs.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact queued plan/revision/fence/source binding and bounded lease; pre/post-CAS owner/task revalidation before returning receipt; failed postcheck freezes continuation. Cancel only with paid flags false and clean authority. Preserve exact original chain and duplicate refresh key. No provider execution in journal controller.

rollback: Revert only the reviewed feature changes while preserving all historical CAS records and pending financial exposure. Keep paid flags disabled. Never reopen old approvals, modify main/Production or apply the agent patch to the real product.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Exact field and manifest validation reject extra credential keys, wrong values and malformed configuration event chains.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact source/runtime/task/owner/workspace bindings and fresh review receipts reject old approvals and substituted deployments.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing organization Redis CAS permits one claim and one operation dispatch; durable markers survive restart and lost acknowledgments.
negativePaths.cancellation: Revocation and canceled tasks cannot create model authority; physical preparation is recorded before I/O and missing destruction acknowledgment blocks continuation.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Closed attempts and revoked grants are insufficient: failed, missing or corrupt physical destruction evidence prevents new paid admission.
negativePaths.api-outage: Unknown provider acknowledgments remain unresolved; no automatic deployment or model retry is permitted. Owner status is read-only recovery.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Worker/nonowner/cross-workspace identities cannot journal, enroll, activate, impersonate reviewers or publish.
negativePaths.spending-limit: At most ten serial fresh attempts share four USD new retained exposure, also bounded by the unchanged five-USD ledger. Unknown counting charges remain pending, no provider hard-cap claim.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Incomplete configuration ACK chain cannot authorize execution. Model usage remains recorded on artifact failure; no generated-code execution or publication.

defects.rootCause: Configuration intent has a24hour lifetime but its preparation task expires after10minutes; sequential provider mutations can outlast it and acknowledgment then fails closed.
defects.detectionGap: Prior fixtures completed all ordered steps under a short clock and did not exercise operator preparation beyond the paid task deadline.
defects.regression: Pure lifecycle and actual profile/controller tests cover bounded configuration lease, expired paid tasks, canceled/revised plans, post-CAS revocation, preserved partial chain and cancellation replay.
defects.historicalPrevention: Preserve original21-event intent with missing ACK and canceled refresh. Never manufacture ACKs or rerun unknown operations. New same-source IDs cannot bypass original duplicate key.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing configuration journal/controller only; no new provider, ledger, orchestration or permission system.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No dependencies or new infrastructure; dedicated credential values remain untouched.
proactiveReview.threats: Paid authority escalation, cross-owner cancellation, canceled task reuse, unsafe duplicate provider writes and false provider verification.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Any unconfirmed step blocks continuation; old records without lease never inherit exception. Terminal cancellation grants no completion, funding, acceptance or publication.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Deterministic old/new records, timed lease boundaries, task/fence/revision mutations, owner revocation around CAS, unknown ACK and false shutdown assertions.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Engineering Auditor review actual implementation and bounded tests. Automated technical review is not independently authenticated human acceptance.
proactiveReview.recovery: All three actual future flags false, attempted snapshot canceled, preparation task canceled and qualified feature alias unchanged. Owner cancellation preserves intent/events and financial rows; exact reviewed successor requires new source/task evidence.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused verification and independent review precede STRICT, Redis, CI, CodeQL and authenticated hosted Preview qualification. No new paid requests before all release and owner gates pass.
